bibl.title: Medea Norsa al liceo classico di Massa: dieci lettere inedite.
bibl.seg: Carlo Pernigotti, Medea Norsa al liceo classico di Massa: dieci lettere inedite.
bibl.note: Ten inedited letters of the great italian papyrologist Medea Norsa kept in the archives of Liceo Pellegrino Rossi, Massa. They, with some other documents, can shed a little new light on her lifelong and often neglected career in the Italian High School during the years of Gentile's Reform.
